subject: bee-scouts
thesis: bee-scouts reads as a proposal board rather than a shipping repo: the issues are specific and self-limiting about what a reader can verify, but every live page shows proposals still open and the run's own commit data counts only one real commit recently, so the value is in the documented convention, not in confirmed output.

claims.label: FACT

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Issue #113 says it could not fetch the four model card pages, so it cannot confirm any stated name, publisher, licence, context window or parameter count, and says the public index shows no Hugging Face dataset under hivepunk-1071-f79faf84.

claims.label: DERIVED
claims.text: The issues read show proposals awaiting a human decision rather than accepted changes.
claims.math: Each of issues #85, #146, #81 and #106 is shown on its own live page as Open with the bee-proposal label and the text 'a person decides'; no page among them shows a merge or a published artifact, so on the pages read all four remain proposals.

claims.label: DERIVED
claims.text: The repository's recent commit activity is mostly automated bookkeeping, not feature work.
claims.math: The commits API response counts 20 raw commits and 1 real one in the last 30 days, so 19 of 20 are not counted as real work by that same source.

claims.label: UNKNOWN

Issue #106's body states the dataset it proposes has no independent verification of the stated fields, and #81 uses the string 'UNKNOWN' for values not actually read back, so blank or UNKNOWN cells are not proof of anything…
